meta.name: Turkey
meta.blurb: Seven fronts from the Danube to the Tigris. Restore the empire of Süleyman.
meta.pitch: a 1936 grand-strategy war map of Turkey
meta.capitalFalls: The Grand National Assembly withdraws to Sivas. The war goes on.
meta.capitalFreed: Ankara is free again. The Assembly returns to the capital.

landmarks.desc: Raise the standard over Buda, the “Red Apple” of the old campaigns
Enter Baghdad, as the army did in 1638

days.text: Cumhuriyet Bayramı kutlu olsun. The Republic keeps its birthday on every front.
23 Nisan. The Assembly first sat in Ankara on this day in 1920.
19 Mayıs. A landing at Samsun began it all.

meta.motto: Yurtta sulh, cihanda sulh — “Peace at home, peace in the world.”
